description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Config, which manages configuration directives for the HTML Purifier library. It includes methods for getting, setting, loading configurations, and handling related definitions and caches.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Config
classes.description: Class responsible for managing and manipulating the configuration directives for HTML Purifier, including loading from files or arrays, validation, and cache management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create or return existing configuration objects based on input.

methods.name: inherit
methods.description: Creates a new configuration that inherits from an existing configuration.

methods.name: createDefault
methods.description: Creates a default configuration object based on the default schema.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration directive.

methods.name: getBatch
methods.description: Retrieves all directives for a specific namespace.

methods.name: getBatchSerial
methods.description: Returns a SHA-1 hash representing the current state of a namespace's configuration.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns a SHA-1 hash of the entire configuration object.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all directives organized by namespace.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration directive to a specified value.

methods.name: getHTMLDefinition
methods.description: Returns the HTML definition object.

methods.name: getCSSDefinition
methods.description: Returns the CSS definition object.

methods.name: getURIDefinition
methods.description: Returns the URI definition object.

methods.name: maybeGetRawDefinition
methods.description: Returns a raw (unprocessed) version of a specified definition.

methods.name: maybeGetRawHTMLDefinition
methods.description: Returns a raw HTML definition.

methods.name: maybeGetRawCSSDefinition
methods.description: Returns a raw CSS definition.

methods.name: maybeGetRawURIDefinition
methods.description: Returns a raw URI definition.

methods.name: loadArray
methods.description: Loads configuration directives from an array.

methods.name: loadIni
methods.description: Loads configuration directives from an ini file.

methods.name: isFinalized
methods.description: Checks if the configuration object is finalized.

methods.name: autoFinalize
methods.description: Automatically finalizes the configuration if auto-finalize is enabled.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Prevents further modifications to the configuration.

methods.name: mergeArrayFromForm
methods.description: Merges configuration directives from a form array.

methods.name: loadArrayFromForm
methods.description: Prepares and loads configuration directives from a form array.

methods.name: prepareArrayFromForm
methods.description: Prepares an array from form data for use in configuration loading.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the configuration object for storage or transfer.
